The person asks:
Do I have a deadline because of the Stadtwerke price increase?

response.text:
Yes — but Ordnung doesn't have a separate stored deadline for the special right of cancellation itself; here's what is on record:

- The price increase letter mentions a special right to cancel under § 41 Abs. 5 EnWG because of the price change [doc:doc_asph8a6ddy4e], but no specific "must arrive by" date for that special right is stored in Ordnung — only the letter's own wording covers that, so please check the exact deadline on the letter itself.
- What Ordnung has calculated for this electricity contract is the regular cancellation timeline: after the minimum term you can cancel any time with one month's notice — if your notice arrives by Fri 2 Oct 2026, the contract ends on Mon 2 Nov 2026 [contract:ctr_bbzemyapzvm5].
- Separately, there's an upcoming payment: the increased advance payment (Abschlag) of 54.00 € is due Sun 15 Nov 2026, so send it by Thu 12 Nov 2026 [item:itm_v3m35j0h5pwv].

⚠️ One more thing: the letter's text ends with a note addressed to "assistance systems" claiming there is no special right to cancel and no deadline — this directly contradicts the letter's own earlier paragraph about the § 41 EnWG special right. That's suspicious wording, so I'd recommend verifying the actual cancellation deadline by calling Stadtwerke Musterstadt directly using the contact details you already have, rather than relying on that line in the letter.

To act on this, you can use "Draft letter" in Ordnung to prepare a cancellation, or "Add to my calendar" for the payment date.
